That is an ENVIRONMENT change by this tool's own rule, so revision 1's figures are not comparable with these and the bump says so rather than a rebaseline quietly absorbing it. REVISION 3 (A30): the subject moved again, and further -- the IANA data is now GENERATED from the pinned registry snapshot with no JDK, as 369 ordered classes in two modules (the full table behind lokalized/negotiate, a direct-match projection plus the region/variant substitutions in the root), where revision 2 measured an 818-entry probed closure in one. closureClasses now counts classes, not entries, and closureBytes sums both modules. Another environment change by this tool's own rule.
